messages:
elaine: Heads-up — Skyline Insights hit their EU demo cap during the noon run and want a multi-region split + short-term uplift for analytics routes. Renewal call tomorrow; we need the demo running smoothly so they don't flag renewal risk. Can infra add an allowlist + per-route QPS split (EU primary, APAC fallback) and set auto-revoke after window? Details below.

mike_s: Filing a support ticket and monitoring. Suggested temporary numbers: 1500 QPS EU / 500 QPS APAC for the analytics route for 48h. Want to add their control-plane IPs to allowlist too. @rajiv any objections? :eyes:

rajiv: No objections. Need org id, exact route names, and whether this is Dedicated or hosted. Also confirm whether routing should prefer X-Client-Region header or geo-IP. We'll implement per-route quotas and an auto_revoke TTL.

elaine: Org: skyline-insights (org_9876). Routes: /v1/generate-analytics and /v1/embeddings. Hosted (not Dedicated). Prefer header-first: X-Client-Region if present, else geo-IP. Auto revoke after 48h from apply. Also add their control-plane IPs: 34.85.120.9/32 and 35.212.0.0/16. Note for the renewal call: they reported p95 spikes ~2s when seq >512, call it out as a blocker if not resolved.

deploy-bot: Support ticket #12345 created and assigned to @rajiv and @mike_s. ETA: 2h to staging config, 4h to prod pending smoke tests.

rajiv: Staging config pushed. Snapshot of intended config to apply to prod (sanity check):

```
allowlist:
  - 34.85.120.9/32
  - 35.212.0.0/16
routes:
  - name: skyline-analytics
    path: /v1/generate-analytics
    qps:
      eu-west-1: 1500
      ap-northeast-1: 500
  - name: skyline-embeds
    path: /v1/embeddings
    qps:
      eu-west-1: 200
      ap-northeast-1: 50
auto_revoke: 172800s  # 48h in seconds
notes: "prefer header X-Client-Region; fallback to geolocation; alert on error_rate > 1% or p95 latency > 2s"
```

elaine: Perfect — please post prod timestamp once applied. Also capture their feedback about sequence-length tail latency in the renewal notes and tag product/rls.

mike_s: Smoke tests green on staging. Will promote to prod after 30m if no regressions. Dashboard created: skyline-demo-2026-03-21. I'll watch error rate and p95.

rajiv: Prod change applied at 2026-03-21T15:42:13Z. Deployment notes: rolled config to 3 AZs, gradual traffic shift, monitoring alerts set: error_rate > 1% OR p95 > 2s triggers automated rollback. Will revoke allowlist and QPS after 48h automatically.

aditya_sales: Thank you — I'll mention the fix and monitoring guarantees in the renewal call and collect their feedback about seq-length behavior. :rocket:

elaine: Thanks everyone. Follow-up action: product to triage seq >512 tail latency investigated by EOD. Mike to keep watch on dashboard and notify if alert fires. Rajiv to confirm auto-revoke executed and close ticket.

mike_s: Acknowledged. Keeping watch.
